name: opencode-kiro
description: Kiro provider plugin for OpenCode: AWS Builder ID / Identity Center login and OpenAI compatible local gateway for CodeWhisperer streaming.

scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external '@opencode-ai/*'
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
